description.html: Arcadia Solar Basking Spotlight 75W is a heat bulb that creates a warm basking spot in the terrarium. Arcadia says its Solar Basking lamps emit mostly infrared energy (mainly IR-A), and the packaging of this bulb states that it also provides UVA, which aids well-being and colour vision in reptiles. It screws into a standard E27 socket.

The 75 W rating is the middle option, suitable for medium-sized terrariums and species that need a stronger basking spot. It is often chosen when 50 W does not reach the target temperature and 100 W would be too strong for the height of the terrarium.

Fit the bulb in a ceramic socket on one side of the terrarium, so there is a warm basking zone and a cooler side for resting. The manufacturer recommends using it with a thermostat and alongside species-appropriate UVB lighting, because a spot bulb does not provide UVB. Check the basking temperature with a thermometer and adjust the lamp height or wattage to suit your animal.
